_note: Free-tier / promo status of AI API providers, verified 2026-07. Limits change often — update last_verified when you confirm. credit_card=false means no card needed to use the free tier. Promos may require opt-in (data sharing, etc.).

providers.name: Google AI Studio (Gemini)
providers.free_tier: Gemini 2.5 Flash ~1,500 req/day (15 RPM), 2.5 Pro 25 req/day, 1M-token context. Permanent, no expiry.

providers.name: Groq
providers.free_tier: Llama 4 / Qwen3 / Gemma at ~30 RPM, up to ~14,400 req/day on small models. Very fast (LPU).

providers.name: OpenRouter
providers.free_tier: ~25+ free `:free` models (rotates monthly) + `openrouter/free` auto-router. 20 RPM / 50 RPD free; $10 top-up -> 1,000 RPD. No card.
providers.promo: New accounts get free trial credits.

providers.name: Hugging Face Inference API
providers.free_tier: Thousands of open models, rate-limited per model. No card.

providers.name: Cloudflare Workers AI
providers.free_tier: 10,000 neurons/day, 50+ open models at the edge (LLM, image, speech). No card.

providers.name: Cerebras
providers.free_tier: Up to ~1M tokens/day free, 2,000+ tok/s on Llama 3.3 70B. No card.

providers.name: Mistral AI
providers.free_tier: La Plateforme Experiment tier: all models (Mistral Large, Codestral) ~1B tokens/month, ~1 req/s. Le Chat Free $0/mo (~25 msgs/day). SMS verify, no card.
providers.promo: Mistralship startup program up to ~$30K credits.

providers.name: NVIDIA NIM
providers.free_tier: 1,000 free credits, Nemotron / Llama / Mistral. No card.

providers.name: Together AI
providers.free_tier: $1 signup credit, 200+ models (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek). No card.

providers.name: Fireworks AI
providers.free_tier: $1 free credits, fast LLM + image inference. No card.

providers.name: DeepSeek
providers.free_tier: Free chat web + ~5M signup tokens for API; then pay-as-you-go (prepaid).

providers.name: xAI Grok
providers.free_tier: Paid API normally; promo credits via data-sharing opt-in.
providers.promo: Up to ~$175/mo free API credits if you opt into data sharing.

providers.name: GitHub Models
providers.free_tier: 100+ models with generous daily limits, OpenAI-compatible. No card (GitHub account).

providers.name: Ollama (self-hosted)
providers.free_tier: Run Llama, Qwen3.5, Gemma, Hermes locally. Unlimited, no rate limits, no card — needs your hardware.

providers.name: Replicate
providers.free_tier: Free credits for new users; image/video/audio models.

providers.name: Cohere
providers.free_tier: Free tier with monthly usage (embeddings, chat, rerank). No card.

providers.name: SiliconFlow
providers.free_tier: Free (limited) inference for open models (Qwen, DeepSeek, etc.). No card.

providers.name: Zhipu AI (GLM)
providers.free_tier: Free tier for GLM models. No card.

providers.name: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio (Qwen)
providers.free_tier: Qwen API free (reduced) tier; chat app fully free. No card for trial.
providers.promo: Trial tokens per model for new accounts.

providers.name: Modal
providers.free_tier: $30/mo free compute credits, great for self-hosted inference.

providers.name: OpenAI
providers.free_tier: Limited free tier (GPT-3.5-class) + ChatGPT free chat. Trial credits largely discontinued.

providers.name: Anthropic Claude
providers.free_tier: Claude free chat (~30-100 msgs/day). API: one-time starter credit only.
providers.promo: One-time ~$5 API credit for new accounts.

providers.name: Nebius AI Studio
providers.free_tier: ~$1 trial credit, 60+ open models (Llama, DeepSeek, Qwen). No card to start.
providers.promo: Up to $5,000 via Nebius for Startups.

providers.name: SambaNova Cloud
providers.free_tier: $5 free API credits (30-day), fast RDU inference for Llama/Qwen. No card to start.

providers.name: Perplexity
providers.free_tier: Free chat: ~5 Deep Research + 3 Pro searches/day, unlimited quick search. No card.
providers.promo: Comet browser free for all users.

providers.name: OVHcloud AI Endpoints
providers.free_tier: Free (limited) inference for open models (Llama, Mistral, Bielik). No card.

providers.name: Chutes.ai
providers.free_tier: Free tier for open models (DeepSeek, Qwen, Llama) via OpenAI-compatible API. No card.

providers.name: Glhf.chat
providers.free_tier: Free OpenAI-compatible API for many open models. No card.

providers.name: AI21 Labs
providers.free_tier: Free tier with monthly usage (Jamba, Maestro). No card.

providers.name: Exa (web search API)
providers.free_tier: Free tier for AI web search / retrieval API. No card.
